title: Lamb Koftas with Smoky Tunisian Flair
description: Indulge in the flavors of Tunisia with these smoky lamb koftas, perfect for a warm evening.

ingredients.name: Lamb
ingredients.notes: Ground lamb is ideal for koftas.

instructions: 1. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
2. In a large bowl, combine the ground lamb, smoky quenched tunisian chili paste, grill seasoning, salt, and pepper. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
3. Divide the lamb mixture into 8-10 portions, depending on desired kofta size.
4. Shape each portion into a ball and then flatten slightly into a disk shape.
5. Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
6. Grill the koftas for 4-5 minutes per side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 63°C.
7. Remove the koftas from the grill and let them rest for a few minutes.
8. Serve the koftas hot, garnished with chopped parsley and accompanied by Lebanese bread if desired.
9. Enjoy the smoky flavors of Tunisia!
